mainEntity.name: What types of paint are best for kitchen cabinets?

acceptedAnswer.text: For kitchen cabinets, durable and washable paints are recommended due to the environment's exposure to moisture, grease, and frequent cleaning. Alkyd enamel (oil-based) offers excellent durability and a smooth finish, though it has a longer drying time and stronger odor. Water-based acrylic-alkyd hybrids combine the durability of alkyd with easier cleanup and lower VOCs. The best choice often depends on your desired finish, existing cabinet material, and how quickly you need to use your kitchen again. We can help you select a paint that balances durability with your aesthetic preferences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Durable and washable paints like alkyd enamel or water-based acrylic-alkyd hybrids are best for kitchen cabinets. The choice depends on desired finish and drying time.
